# China Travel

> > Comprehensive China travel planning resource covering tours, high-speed rail booking, Great Wall visits, and destination guides across Beijing, Shanghai, Tibet, and beyond.

China Travel specializes in helping international visitors navigate China's top destinations with practical guides for transportation (especially high-speed trains), tour packages, seasonal travel advice, and detailed information on iconic sites like the Great Wall, Yangtze River cruises, and Tibet. The site provides expert planning resources for both independent travelers and those seeking organized tours.

## Key Topics

- Great Wall of China access and sections
- High-speed rail booking and schedules
- Beijing and Shanghai travel planning
- Tibet permits and altitude travel
- Mutianyu and Jiankou Great Wall
- Train routes between major cities
- Seasonal travel timing and weather
- Yangtze River cruises
- Zhangjiajie Avatar Mountains
- Water town day trips (Suzhou, Hangzhou)
- Airport to attraction transportation
- Ethnic minority cultural tours
- Yellow Mountain (Huangshan) hiking
- Layover tour planning
- China tourism regulations

## High-Speed Rail & Train Travel

- [China High-Speed Trains, Tickets Booking, Realtime Schedule](https://www.chinatravel.com/china-trains): China train ticket booking service: high-speed rail schedules & reservations
- [Hong Kong - Shanghai Train: Tickets Booking, Time, Price](https://www.chinatravel.com/china-trains/hong-kong-shanghai-train): Hong Kong-Shanghai high-speed trains G100/G99: 8 hrs, $128-$408
- [Shanghai - Guangzhou Trains: High-speed Train and Overnight Train, Time, Price](https://www.chinatravel.com/china-trains/shanghai-guangzhou-train): Shanghai-Guangzhou trains: 7hr high-speed & weekend overnight options
- [Hong Kong - Dongguan High Speed Train -Ticket Booking](https://www.chinatravel.com/china-trains/hong-kong-dongguan-train): Hong Kong-Dongguan high-speed trains: 50min-1h20, CNY 178-373
- [How to Travel from Shanghai to Suzhou, Shanghai Airport to Suzhou  - Train, Bus and Private Transfer](https://www.chinatravel.com/shanghai/how-to-travel-from-shanghai-to-suzhou): Shanghai to Suzhou high-speed train guide: 30 mins, airport transfers

## Great Wall Visiting Guides

- [Best Way to Get to the Great Wall from Beijing City](https://www.chinatravel.com/great-wall-of-china/beijing-to-greatwall): Transportation options to Mutianyu & Badaling from Beijing: taxi, bus, train
- [Beijing Airport to Great wall: Map, the Best Way to Great Wall, How to Get to the Great Wall](https://www.chinatravel.com/great-wall-of-china/beijing-airport-to-greatwall): Beijing Capital & Daxing airports to Great Wall: taxi & private car options
- [How to Plan a Great Wall Layover Tour from Beijing Airport](https://www.chinatravel.com/great-wall-of-china/greatwall-layover-tour): Great Wall layover tour planning from Beijing Capital & Daxing airports
- [Jiankou Great Wall - The Wall Built on Cliffs](https://www.chinatravel.com/great-wall-of-china/jiankou-great-wall): Precipitous Jiankou Great Wall section with 70-90° slopes near Beijing
- [Simatai Great Wall - Explore the Great Wall at Night](https://www.chinatravel.com/great-wall-of-china/simatai-great-wall): Simatai Great Wall night tours and hiking in Miyun District, Beijing
- [Shanghai to the Great Wall - How to Visit the Great Wall from Shanghai](https://www.chinatravel.com/great-wall-of-china/shanghai-to-greatwall): Day trip guide from Shanghai to Great Wall near Beijing (1,200km)
